comparison.objective: Seat and tighten a positive battery cable clamp, versus adjust and commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Clamp seating and wrench tightening differ from setscrew unlocking, controlled collar tuning, counterholding, relocking, and dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Clamp seated, nut turned within range, lug aligned, wrench safely cleared versus two acceptable impacts and witness-tested collar retention.
comparison.reason: Tool tightening and final clearance are generic shared primitives; the candidate adds a materially different adjustable mechanism and closed-loop commissioning test.
